✨ Boundaries are my love language.

Saying "no" isn't closing a door — it's opening the one that leads back to you. When you honour your limits, you make room for the kind of love that nourishes instead of drains.

This week, let one boundary be an act of self-devotion. 🤍 Pull a card, breathe, and let your intuition lead.

Some weeks ask more of us than others. If you're moving through something heavy right now, this is your gentle reminder: you don't have to hold it all alone.

Our Cancer Care Compassionate Communication cards were made for exactly these moments — soft prompts to help you speak what's tender, ask for what you need, and let others walk beside you.

Healing isn't a straight line. Wherever you are on the path today, you're doing beautifully. 🤍

POV: you pull one card and it reads you like a diary 📖✨
